title: Vikram and Betal: The Clever Thief
moral: Wrong actions will always be revealed.

scenes.summary: Betal tells a story about a clever thief.
scenes.text: Betal told Vikram about a thief who was very clever.
scenes.image_prompt: vikram carrying betal in forest cartoon style

scenes.text: The thief stole a bag of gold from a merchant.
scenes.image_prompt: thief stealing gold bag at night cartoon

scenes.text: The thief hid the gold under a tree and acted innocent.
scenes.image_prompt: thief hiding gold under tree cartoon

scenes.text: The guards found the gold where the thief pointed.
scenes.image_prompt: guards digging under tree and finding gold cartoon

scenes.text: A wise officer realized the truth and caught the thief. Vikram answered wisely, and Betal flew away.
scenes.image_prompt: guards catching thief while officer points cartoon

story: A clever thief tried to escape by pretending to help guards find stolen gold. But his knowledge revealed him. A wise officer caught him. Vikram said wrong actions are always revealed.
